newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Italian soldier badly wounded in Vlore shooting.
newsitem.headline: Italian soldier badly wounded in Vlore shooting.

text.p: An Italian soldier was badly wounded in shooting in the Adriatic port of Vlore on Monday and was flown to Bari in Italy for emergency treatment, an Italian military doctor said.
Stefano Maisto, 23, from Lecce in Italy, was hit by a Kalashnikov bullet that perforated his lung and the membrane of his heart, military doctor Colonel Luigi Marino told Reuters.
Asked whether the young soldier's life was in danger, Marino said: "Yes, it is a very bad wound."

He was shot outside the Italian military hospital in Vlore, where Italian troops have been based since April as part of a multinational protection force deployed to try to restore a measure of calm after unrest erupted in March.

Wild shooting broke out in Vlore early in the afternoon following rumours that Albanian President Sali Berisha had resigned. Berisha appeared on television to concede the defeat of his Democratic Party in Sunday's general election but did not say he was stepping down.
